annotations.title: Capabilities and the listings for each

description: Every capability the directory tracks (inference.llm, web.search, web.scrape, data.company, payments.x402, …) with the best listings that provide it and how many do. prefix narrows it, e.g. 'web.', and limit says how many listings each (default 5).

prefix.description: Only capabilities whose id starts with this, e.g. web. or data.
